description: Graph analysis (shortest path, components, centrality) — Analyze any network from an edge list. edges=from,to[,weight];... (directed=true for one-way edges; nodes= adds isolated nodes). Returns density, degrees, connected components (strongly connected + cycle detection + topological order for directed graphs), bipartite check and minimum spanning tree (undirected), diameter/radius/center, average shortest path, top betweenness, closeness, PageRank and degree. from= gives distances to every node; from= + to= gives the shortest path (Dijkstra, or Bellman-Ford with negative weights and negative-cycle detection). Offline; up to 1,000 nodes / 5,000 edges (centrality on smaller graphs). Useful for dependency graphs, routing, org charts, service maps. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_graph
